name: baton
description: Hand a coding task from one AI agent to another without re-explaining it.

interface.shortDescription: Hand a task to another AI agent
interface.longDescription: Keeps the state of a coding task in plain files in your repository and briefs whichever agent works next, so you can switch between Codex, Claude Code and others without re-explaining the task. The briefing is checked against git, so a session that was cut off mid-turn is reported as stale.
defaultPrompt: start a handoff for this task.
